conditions: For this quantity's worst case over admissible public encodings, use the source construction's $q=n-r_0$.
applicability.dimension_conditions: Assume $m,n\ge C_0k/\epsilon$. The source hard subclass uses integer $r_0=\Theta(k/\epsilon)$ and $q=n-r_0$, requiring $r_0+k$ rows; extra rows may be zero padded.
applicability.guarantee_mapping: Success probability is at least 2/3 for each fixed admissible encoded input. Randomized state transitions are allowed, and the original sufficient-dimension conditions remain in force.
applicability.oracle_mapping: The rows arrive once in a fixed order, with entries exactly encoded over a finite alphabet. Persistent state is finite-bit. Matrix-vector access, rereading, and additional passes are unavailable.
applicability.output_mapping: Return an encoding of a right rank-$k$ subspace, with a $(1+\epsilon)$ relative guarantee for squared Frobenius residual. The hard instance uses only the source's finite alphabet.
applicability.output_metric_mapping: After the stream ends, use only the retained state to return $P=P^{\mathsf T}=P^2\in\mathbb R^{n\times n}$ with $\operatorname{rank}(P)=k$; an orthonormal-basis representation is allowed. Returning $AP$ is unnecessary. Let $A_k$ be any best rank-$k$ Frobenius approximation. Success requires $\|A(I_n-P)\|_{\mathrm F}^2\le(1+\varepsilon)\|A-A_k\|_{\mathrm F}^2$, explicitly using squared residual. A zero optimal residual requires exact row-space recovery.
applicability.resource_mapping: The native resource is peak retained bits $S_{\mathrm{bit}}$. One pass is a fixed protocol and is not added to memory cost. Preserve input encoding, working state, and output encoding. The cap holds for each input and private seed. Final output must decode from charged state, without unrecorded external storage.

impact.argument: Retain the exact accepted native b1 lower and b2 upper, including their view main/g1/q1/resource and all original R guards. The minimax quantity is worst-case over the admissible public encodings q, not an individually fixed-q complexity. The b1 source construction supplies S_bits^star >= c n k/epsilon on R. The fully charged deterministic construction p_store supplies S_bits^star <= 3mn+O(n+log(mn)+1) <= C mn with universal C on D, uniformly in the public q, using the existing symbolic-output contract and no additional input access. Since k<min(m,n), both m,n>=2 and the stated overhead is absorbed uniformly. On S=R intersect{m<=2 C_0 k/epsilon}, the upper is at most 2 C C_0 n k/epsilon. Thus c n k/epsilon <= S_bits^star <= 2 C C_0 n k/epsilon: Theta(nk/epsilon), with only universal source constants C_0,epsilon_0 fixed, never hiding m,n,k,epsilon or q. This also equals Theta(mn) on S since C_0 k/epsilon<=m<=2 C_0 k/epsilon. The upper succeeds deterministically and has the native pathwise memory cap, hence preserves per-input success >=2/3. Its finite-label charged output handles zero optimal residual and rank deficiency by the existing canonical exact spectral interpretation; we do not replace it with a numerical coordinate-output algorithm or free external eigensolver. No new output, finite precision, RAM-word, oracle/pass or q-pointwise assumption is introduced. S is nonempty as a parameter region: set k=1, choose epsilon=min(epsilon_0/2,C_0/4,1/4)>0, and m=n=ceil(C_0/epsilon); C_0/epsilon>=4 ensures m<=2 C_0/epsilon and k<min(m,n). Outside S the old c1 remains polynomial_gap on R, and D minus R remains unassessed. This is publication of a closure already explicitly stated in the baseline joint annotation, not a new source theorem, a strict extension beyond R, or a full-domain minimax solution.

argument: Assign three-bit labels to the five permitted entry values. Duplicate values when q=1 cause no difficulty. Append all mn labels in stream order. A current-row buffer, counters, fixed control and output constructor tag use O(n+log(mn)+1) further bits. Since m,n>=2, the peak and final descriptor sizes are at most 3mn+O(n+log(mn)+1)=O(mn). The bound holds deterministically. Public m,n,k,q are available to the interpretation; no digits of q are stored.

The output is the retained label array interpreted by a fixed symbolic subspace constructor. It denotes the leading k-dimensional eigenspace of G=A^T A, reconstructing A from its labels and public q. To resolve eigenvalue ties, order distinct eigenvalues decreasingly; in each eigenspace project e_1,...,e_n onto that eigenspace and Gram-Schmidt in this order, skipping zero remainders and taking positive normalizing roots. Concatenate the resulting orthonormal lists and select their first k vectors. This uniquely defines P=sum_{j<=k}u_j u_j^T.

This constructor is the mathematical interpretation of the permitted symbolic output, not a numerical eigensolver executed in uncharged working space. Every input-dependent datum in that representation remains in the charged label array. For each integer q all entries are algebraic, and the canonical spectral rule has a computable exact interpretation. No input rereading, external cache, evaluated coordinates or exact-real registers are used by the streaming computation. A model requiring evaluated coordinate output would need a different proof; the frozen view expressly permits symbolic subspace descriptions.

Let lambda_1>=...>=lambda_n>=0 be the eigenvalues of G. For any rank-k orthogonal Q, its diagonal weights w_j in this eigenbasis lie in [0,1] and sum to k. Moving weight to larger eigenvalues gives tr(GQ)=sum lambda_j w_j <= sum_{j<=k}lambda_j. The constructed P attains equality, hence ||A(I-P)||_F^2=sum_{j>k}lambda_j.

For any rank-at-most-k matrix B, extend its row space to a k-dimensional subspace with projector Q. Orthogonality gives ||A-B||_F^2=||A(I-Q)||_F^2+||AQ-B||_F^2 >= sum_{j>k}lambda_j. B=AP attains equality. Thus the output achieves exactly ||A-A_k||_F^2, meeting g1 for every epsilon>0 with probability one. If rank(A)<k, canonical nullspace vectors complete the subspace to rank exactly k, with zero residual.

The construction is uniform in m,n,k,epsilon and public q, including k=1, q=1 and zero optimal residual. Its proof applies on D; this local native adoption is restricted to the unchanged registered R.

proofs.statement: Under the existing symbolic-subspace-output contract, deterministic one-pass storage of the finite entry labels achieves the optimal rank-k squared Frobenius residual with O(mn) charged bits.

proofs.body: Retain the exact accepted native b1 lower and b2 upper, including their view main/g1/q1/resource and all original R guards. The minimax quantity is worst-case over the admissible public encodings q, not an individually fixed-q complexity. The b1 source construction supplies S_bits^star >= c n k/epsilon on R. The fully charged deterministic construction p_store supplies S_bits^star <= 3mn+O(n+log(mn)+1) <= C mn with universal C on D, uniformly in the public q, using the existing symbolic-output contract and no additional input access. Since k<min(m,n), both m,n>=2 and the stated overhead is absorbed uniformly. On S=R intersect{m<=2 C_0 k/epsilon}, the upper is at most 2 C C_0 n k/epsilon. Thus c n k/epsilon <= S_bits^star <= 2 C C_0 n k/epsilon: Theta(nk/epsilon), with only universal source constants C_0,epsilon_0 fixed, never hiding m,n,k,epsilon or q. This also equals Theta(mn) on S since C_0 k/epsilon<=m<=2 C_0 k/epsilon. The upper succeeds deterministically and has the native pathwise memory cap, hence preserves per-input success >=2/3. Its finite-label charged output handles zero optimal residual and rank deficiency by the existing canonical exact spectral interpretation; we do not replace it with a numerical coordinate-output algorithm or free external eigensolver. No new output, finite precision, RAM-word, oracle/pass or q-pointwise assumption is introduced. S is nonempty as a parameter region: set k=1, choose epsilon=min(epsilon_0/2,C_0/4,1/4)>0, and m=n=ceil(C_0/epsilon); C_0/epsilon>=4 ensures m<=2 C_0/epsilon and k<min(m,n). The source lower still ranges over its own legal encoding subclass, not necessarily q=1. The equality m=2 C_0 k/epsilon is included whenever integral; epsilon=epsilon_0 is not. Outside S the old c1 remains polynomial_gap on R, and D minus R remains unassessed. This is publication of a closure already explicitly stated in the baseline joint annotation, not a new source theorem, a strict extension beyond R, or a full-domain minimax solution.

title: Low-rank approximation from a finite-bit row stream: one-pass memory

algorithms.adaptivity: The state may depend on past inputs; the input order cannot be chosen.
description_paragraphs: Randomized computable one-pass streaming algorithms are allowed. The retained state is a finite bit string, including random-generator state under the declared memory model. No span or running-time restriction is added beyond one pass and bit memory.
algorithms.description_zh: Randomized computable one-pass streaming algorithms are allowed. The retained state is a finite bit string, including random-generator state under the declared memory model. No span or running-time restriction is added beyond one pass and bit memory.
algorithms.internal_computation: The state between rows is a finite bit string, with randomized computable transitions. A public rule decodes the final output from that state. The output may be a symbolic subspace description; coordinatewise finite-decimal orthogonalization is not required.
algorithms.parallelism: Sequential row arrivals, with no free parallel copies.

budget.budget_semantics: One pass; peak memory is bounded for every input and random seed.
budget.precision_model: Inputs have exact finite-symbol encoding and persistent state is finite-bit; word width is not free. The source hard instance does not supply a general rounding algorithm, a finite-bit Frequent Directions upper bound, or a uniform output word length.
budget.scalarization: Record passes = 1, peak memory_bits, and stream_rows = m separately. Do not convert them to real-register counts.

guarantees.complete_expression: For every row stream fixed in advance and admitting finite encoding, the squared residual is at most $(1+\epsilon)\mathrm{OPT}_{\mathrm{squared}}$ with probability at least $2/3$. If the optimum is zero, exact residual zero is required.
description_paragraphs: The algorithm is selected using only public inputs. For every admissible input fixed before its private seed is generated, the success event has probability at least $2/3$ over that private randomness.
guarantees.description_zh: The algorithm is selected using only public inputs. For every admissible input fixed before its private seed is generated, the success event has probability at least $2/3$ over that private randomness.
guarantees.quantifier_order: exists algorithm; for every fixed input; Pr_seed(success)>=2/3
